title: Koszul regularity near a source point of an immersion
statement: Let $Z,P$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], $i:Z\to P$ a morphism, and $z\in Z$. Say that $i$ is Koszul-regular near $z$ if there are open subschemes $V\subseteq Z$ and $U\subseteq P$ [def-weil-open-immersion], with $z\in V$, and a closed immersion $j:V\to U$ [def-weil-closed-immersion] whose composite with $U\hookrightarrow P$ is $i|_V$, such that near every point of $V$ the kernel ideal of $j$ has finite Koszul-regular generators [def-weil-pbc-koszul-regular-sequence]. Precisely, use the existing closed-chart predicate $\mathrm{CotangentPresentation.IsKoszulImmersion}(j)$ [def-sfb-koszul-closed-immersion-chart]: for every $x\in V$ there is an affine open $W\subseteq U$ containing $j(x)$, an integer $r\geq0$ and $f:\operatorname{Fin}(r)\to\Gamma(W,\mathcal O_U)$ with $f$ Koszul-regular and $\operatorname{span}(f)=\ker(j^\#)(W)$. The length may vary with $x$ and may be zero.
